feature: Three playable ranged bows with distinct automatic attacks, passives, manual skills and matching art

weapons.name: 疾风短弓
weapons.attack: Fast piercing shots; two bonus arrows every fourth volley

weapons.name: 霜月长弓
weapons.attack: Three-arrow spread with per-volley chill and bounded freeze

weapons.name: 焰星重弓
weapons.attack: Charging explosive arrows and nonstacking burn

unit.campaign_method: Normal movement, dash, manual activation and physical pickups only. No HP, damage, XP, clock, RNG or cooldown overrides. All original twelve blades plus three bows complete their campaign.
